text:
Maya (eng-platform): quick check — where are we with the in-flight optimize toolkit items? specifically: 1) quantization recs for llama-13b variant, 2) batching/cache defaults for medium-latency workloads, 3) any regression alerts from yesterday's QA run?
Jun (eng-ml): short: quant recs landed in the doc, recommending int8 + group-qdq for cpu fallbacks. perf looks good on 1k seq samples (p95 token latency down ~12%) 
Sam (eng-runtime): saw one regression after the small PR that tweaked KV eviction. when batch size > 8 we hit extra memcpy on the hot path. will paste minimal repro.
Sam (eng-runtime): repro snippet: ```env KVS_EVICT=soft && ./run_infer --model llama-13b --batch 12 --seq 512``` causes a ~18% latency bump vs master for that config
Jun (eng-ml): thanks — we can tighten group size to avoid memcpy for that path, but need runtime toggle to avoid breaking canary customers.
Priya (eng-platform): ownership check: who owns the canary rollout for this change? we need a gate: flag + staged rollout to 10% then 50%. @Sam @Jun pls confirm owners so I can set rollout in console.
Sam (eng-runtime): I can own the runtime flag and the rollout hook. will create a feature flag: optkit_kv_eviction_mode = "soft|hard|auto" and expose to console.
Maya (eng-platform): @Sam please also add a fallback policy to route to the older model variant (int8 -> fp16) if p95 spikes > 2x during canary. Priya will coordinate traffic slice.
ci-bot: build #12867 failed: unit tests (kv_cache_test) x3 flaky, one new assertion for memcpy count in hot path — https://ci.redwood/12867/logs
Alex (eng-sre): seeing elevated errors during the staging run between 02:10-02:18 UTC, likely tied to the memcpy perf hit. recommend holding full rollout until hotfix.
Jun (eng-ml): plan: I'll cut a hotfix PR to adjust group-qdq config and add a guard so we only enable the new quant on batch <=8 until runtime flag flips. targeting PR today EOD.
Sam (eng-runtime): I'll open the feature-flag PR and add canary wiring, plus the rollback playbook in the PR description.
Priya (eng-platform): I'll create the rollout ticket and schedule the 10% canary for tomorrow morning 09:00 UTC. adding owners: @Sam (runtime), @Jun (ml), @Maya (platform)
Maya (eng-platform): perfect. final ask — Jun please link PR and perf numbers here when ready, Sam please link flag PR and canary dashboard. we want to close the loop before 09:00. :thumbsup:
Jun (eng-ml): will do, pinging when PR is up.
Sam (eng-runtime): PRs coming in ~2h.
ci-bot: created ticket OPT-4521 for canary rollout and OPT-4522 for hotfix.
Maya (eng-platform): thanks folks — async check complete, will follow up if anything blocks.
